# Change summary

## Verification
- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] Contract/schema tests
- [ ] Integration tests
- [ ] Replay/regression tests
- [ ] Security checks
- [ ] Performance checks where applicable
- [ ] CI passes

## Production checklist
- [ ] No secrets/private data
- [ ] Provenance preserved
- [ ] License/terms considered
- [ ] Observability updated
- [ ] Failure behavior documented
- [ ] Recovery path documented
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Architecture impact reviewed

## Evidence
Include reproducible commands, test results, benchmarks, or other verification.

## Risk / rollback
State material risks and recovery steps.
